svg.title: Three caps change nothing, one collar does
svg.desc: A striker on two rails carries three blank caps stacked on its body. Its rod runs through a yoke toward a belt of blocks. The blocks furthest along the belt stand out of line, all by the same amount. A magenta collar, slid along the rod to the yoke, now stops the stroke short, and the last three blocks, teal, are still in line.
